name: Olivier Chastel - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the choice of performance indicators for audit and budgetary control in the context of financing measures to support the implementation of future European competitiveness
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It says the EU should judge its spending by results, not just by how much money is spent. It wants fewer, clearer measures of success, public data on who receives EU money, and checks that the numbers are reliable. It also wants measures that show whether spending really improves Europe's competitiveness, such as jobs, patents and private investment attracted.

- It asks the Commission to simplify and standardise how EU spending results are measured.
- It affects the Commission, Member States, auditors, businesses and local authorities receiving EU funds.
- Next, the Commission and Member States are asked to act on these recommendations.
